coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Four of seven ground-truth variables are substantively represented (57%): statsmodels-based ACF computation, an adjustable maximum lag T, chronological train/test splitting, and an ACF-peak-derived cycle length.
coverage.design_error_analysis: ETTh1 is only one of multiple datasets rather than the constant dataset. StandardScaler normalization is missing, and no ACF-versus-lag plot is specified; the planned plots instead emphasize MSE and detector comparisons. The design also changes peak selection to maximum absolute ACF after detrending and adds extensive unrelated benchmarking.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Neither an ACF plot showing periodic peaks nor a recommendation for CycleNet's optimal cycle length is provided.
